contentHtml:
Lenovo Repairs Stretton

Lenovo is considered to be one of successful technology companies that designs, develops, manufactures and sells personal computers famous for their ThinkPad and Yoga line of notebooks laptops. In 2015, Lenovo was the world’s largest personal computer vendor by unit sales.

If you are looking an expert yet most affordable Lenovo repair and service in Brisbane, then you came to the right place. Computer Repairs Stretton offers an expert and dedicated repair services for Lenovo products with the most cost-effective repair solutions for all models both old and new. Give us a call at 0477 319 160 and have a consultation with one of our repair experts.

Our Lenovo computer repairs Stretton offers

Lenovo DC jack repair, Lenovo laptops are commonly prone to a loose DC jack problem. If you are stressing your DC jack a lot and it won’t charge anymore, consider to have it repaired or replaced. Computer Repairs Stretton offers Lenovo DC jack repairs as well as other repairs and services in Brisbane.

Lenovo motherboard repair, Motherboard failure can lead to your whole computer to stop functioning. Bring your computer to us and we will have your motherboard checked and repaired.

Lenovo LCD repair and replacement, Does your laptop suffered from a damaged screen or having multi-colored lines blocking parts of your screen? It’s time to have your LCD screen repaired! For the best Lenovo repairs in Brisbane, call Computer Repairs Stretton.

Lenovo backlight repair and replacement, Your LCD backlight is responsible in making your screen display bright and clear. If you suspect that your LCD is not performing good, our expert professionals can have it repaired or replaced, whichever suits the situation.

Lenovo laptop keyboard repair and replacement, Missing keyboard keys? Broken and unresponsive keyboard? Give us a call and have it fixed! We offer nothing but the best Lenovo computer repairs in Brisbane.

Lenovo touch-pad replacement, Does your touch-pad skips when scrolling? Touch-pad hangs and stopped working? We can replace your touch-pad so you can use your laptop smoothly again.

Lenovo inverter replacement, Faded images on your screen? It can be an indicator that your inverter needs a repair or replacement. Call Computer Repairs Stretton and our experts will have it fixed.

Don’t settle for the cheap yet unreliable repair service. We at Computer Repairs Stretton gives utmost value to our customer’s time and money. Our technicians are certified and well experienced on all types of computer repairs and is capable of getting it right the first time around. You can always check what our satisfied customers have to say about our services in our customer reviews. We also consistently won the five-star service award for the year 2014, 2015 and 2016.

Lenovo virus and spyware removal, We offer the best virus and spyware removal anywhere in Brisbane. Our experts know how to effectively identify all kinds of malicious software and how to remove them. There is no complex computer virus removal at Computer Repairs Stretton.

Lenovo desktop and laptop upgrades , Our dedicated Lenovo upgrades are guaranteed to be 100% compatible to your computer systems.

  • Computer reformatting
  • Hardware installation and upgrades
  • PC optimization
  • Performance speedup
  • Operating system installation
  • Lenovo tune-up

Lenovo internet and network setup , If you are seeking for help in setting up your internet connectivity, emails or fixing network problems with your Lenovo computer, call us and we will fix it for you.

Lenovo data and file recovery, It is very common for people to forgot their computer login password and to accidentally delete files and other data in their computer. Don’t panic! There still might be a way to recover what you’ve lost. Give us a call at 0477 319 160 and we will see what we can do.

Other hardware repairs for your Lenovo

  • Lenovo laptop overheating
  • Lenovo laptop LCD screen is very dim or dark
  • Display is only visible on external monitor but not visible on Lenovo laptop monitor
  • Lenovo laptop LCD screen is not turning on
  • Lenovo laptop LCD screen is cracked
  • Lenovo laptop GPU or graphics card problem and distorted display
  • Lenovo laptop power supply repairs
  • Lenovo loose or broken hinge replacement
  • Lenovo LED and CCFL bulb replacement
  • Lenovo optical drive upgrade and replacement (DVD-RW, DVD Burners)
  • Lenovo AC/DC power jack repairs
  • Lenovo replacement of broken or cracked plastic parts (LCD cover and base cover)
  • Lenovo liquid spill repairs (Cola, Water, Coffee, Tea, Wine, Etc.)
  • Lenovo internal dust and particles cleaning
  • Lenovo component level motherboard repairs

Other software repairs for your Lenovo

  • Lenovo laptop data and file backup services
  • Transfer of data to your new hard drive or new Lenovo laptop
  • Solutions for slow working Lenovo laptops
  • Solutions and repairs for Blue Screen of Deaths (BSODs) and freezing symptoms
  • Lenovo laptop driver installation

Custom built Lenovo computer, Not completely satisfied with your Lenovo computer or laptop? We offer the best services and repairs for Lenovo computers in Brisbane. That includes custom built computers. All you have to do is give us the specifications and you’ll have your own custom built computer in no time.

You are always welcome to visit our workshop and bring your Lenovo computer systems to us. Our workshop is open 7 days a week from 7am up to 10pm and even on holidays. Give us a call at 0477 319 160 with no call out fees and we will have a repair service scheduled for you. You can also avail out onsite service so you will no longer have to bring your computer to us, we will bring our services to you. Our onsite service is guaranteed to be free of call out or travel fees. In addition to our one stop repair service, our expert technicians can also perform a remote repair your computer problems that can be easily fixed by remotely. With your permission, we will be accessing your desktop or laptop remotely and fix your computer problems with no extra costs. Check also Lenovo Alexa-Enabled Android Smart Tablet Review.
